'''Andrew Rannells''' (born August 23, 1978 in Omaha, Nebraska as '''Andrew Scott Rannells''') is an American actor, voice actor and singer who was one of the original voice actors for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} by [[4Kids Entertainment]]. He is sometimes credited under the name of '''Andy Rannells'''.

==Pokémon roles==
Rannells first started voicing characters for Pokémon in mid-[[S04|Johto]]. Prior to becoming a voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}, he acted in [[Pokémon Live!]] as [[James]] from {{TRT}}, along with fellow voice actor/director [[Darren Dunstan]] (who portrayed {{an|Giovanni}}). His most prominent role was [[Harley]] until [[S09|season nine]]. When [[Pokémon USA]] took over the dubbing and distribution of the series, Rannells left the series along with most of the other original voice actors.
